ranges.summary: Replaced the initial imports with a new consolidated import from the feedback-records v3 schemas module, bringing in constants and Zod schema building blocks used by the new feedback input definitions.

Introduced feedback-dataset and feedback-record MCP input schemas, including a shared optional `datasetId` field and multiple exported `ZMcp*Input` Zod objects built via `z.object` and `extend` over the imported v3 feedback-record schemas (covering list/get/create/count/update/delete/search/similarity operations, including a batched create input bounded by `MAX_FEEDBACK_RECORDS_PER_BATCH`).

Extended the exported `TMcp*Input` TypeScript inference aliases to include the newly added feedback-related input types, replacing the prior block that only exported inference aliases for survey-related inputs.

Introduces the module and pulls in the required MCP server/types plus the feedback-record v3 operation functions, audit-log helpers, scope/auth utilities, and MCP input schema types used to define tool input contracts.
Defines the MCP authorization scope constants for feedback-record read and write operations.

Adds a reusable `readOnlyHandler` wrapper that derives the MCP request id, guards `feedbackRecords:read` scope, invokes a provided v3 operation, and converts its `Response` into an MCP `CallToolResult`.

Adds a reusable `writeHandler` wrapper that guards `feedbackRecords:write` scope, builds an audit log for the mutation type, stamps audit status based on whether the mutation response is OK, queues the audit log on both success and exceptions, and rethrows errors after ensuring audit logging.

Implements `registerFeedbackRecordTools` registrations for the read-only tools: listing feedback datasets, listing feedback records (spread input into the operation’s filter contract), counting feedback records, and getting a single feedback record by ids, each wired through `readOnlyHandler` with the relevant v3 operation parameters and `MCP_API_ROUTE`.
Registers the `create_feedback_record` write tool with its schema and metadata, wiring it through `writeHandler` so the created record mutation uses the shared audit-log lifecycle.

Registers the `create_feedback_records` write tool with custom async logic that computes an audit-log array per record, queues stamped per-record audit logs on success, and also queues an audit entry even when no audit logs are stamped; on failure it still queues via the same outcome mechanism before rethrowing.
Registers the `update_feedback_record` and `delete_feedback_record` write tools, each wired through `writeHandler` with their respective v3 update/delete operations and audit-log lifecycle.
Registers the `search_feedback_records` read-only tool, wiring query/pagination inputs into the v3 search operation via `readOnlyHandler`, returning only scored match data per the operation contract.
Registers the `find_similar_feedback_records` read-only tool, wiring the similarity search inputs into the v3 “find similar” operation via `readOnlyHandler`.

Adds Vitest imports and module/function imports used by the test suite, and sets up `vi.mock` for the feedback-record operations, audit-log helpers, and logger to fully control and observe tool behavior.

Defines shared identifiers/auth fixtures and a `createToolServer()` helper that captures registered MCP tools; includes tests asserting the ten tools register in a fixed order and that read-only/idempotency/destructive annotations are set correctly for list/count/search vs create/update/delete.
Tests `list_feedback_datasets` handler delegation to `listV3FeedbackDatasets` and verifies structured content mapping from the operations-layer response.
Tests `list_feedback_records` handler filter passthrough to `listV3FeedbackRecords`, and validates insufficient-scope behavior (returns an error and does not call the operations function).
Tests `get_feedback_record` handler calls `getV3FeedbackRecord` with the workspaceId and feedback record id.

Tests `create_feedback_record` handler: (a) delegates to `createV3FeedbackRecord`, (b) builds/queues an audit log for the “created” event and updates `auditLog.status` to success on success, (c) enforces write-scope requirement, and (d) on failure, keeps failure status, ensures `auditLog.eventId` is set for correlation, and queues the failure audit log.

Tests `delete_feedback_record` handler: (a) delegates to `deleteV3FeedbackRecord` and treats a 204/no-content response as success without error, (b) builds/queues an audit log for “deleted” and updates status to success, (c) enforces write-scope restriction (prevents reaching the operation), and (d) on failure, keeps failure status, sets `auditLog.eventId`, and queues the failure audit log.

Tests `search_feedback_records` and `find_similar_feedback_records` handlers: verifies query/params passthrough and structured data mapping for success, and enforces read-scope requirement by asserting no operations call when scopes are missing.

Tests `count_feedback_records` handler: verifies filters and instance injection are passed to `countV3FeedbackRecords`, asserts returned count in structured content, and enforces read-scope requirement.

Tests `create_feedback_records` batch handler: (a) enforces write-scope requirement, (b) verifies audit-event generation semantics for multiple record creations (one audit log per created record with differing statuses), and (c) verifies a single failure audit event is queued when the batch results in no successful creations.

Tests `update_feedback_record` handler: verifies it passes the full input body to `updateV3FeedbackRecord`, builds/queues an “updated” audit log and marks `auditLog.status` as success, and enforces write-scope requirement (prevents calling the operation on insufficient scopes).
